notes.title: Shattered Hourglass: Update 1.16
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! When was the last update... like 3 years ago?
Well, thanks to a bug report provided from Winterwitch18, I've fixed a decade old bug where is the Forest Area where Zulwhern appears, depending on your Karma the event can appear twice. 

So, with this fix after Zulwhern defeated the event won't trigger again.

Take care![/p]

notes.title: Shattered Hourglass: Update 1.15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since our last update. 
Big thanks to Firefly130984's feedback for the game! Here are some fixes and new stuff, enjoy.

[b]Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*]The Suez Canal question is now... something else
[*]Chronix item upgrader now wants Black Belt and then Mark. So that you can get two items.
[*]Sharp Paw is now sellable
[*]Repel Shield = Added what percent of poison it protects
[/list]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mio can talk to the Bull in the... ??? area in the Quiz Lady.
[*]Mio can interact with Trin Island's cow
[*]Mio can talk to every animal in the Player House
[*]Added a dialogue for the Sheep and Rexx in Chronix when talking with Mio
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can no longer clip to the trees in the second map of Haunted Forest
[*]Mio's "Enchance" Spell is actually Enhance spell now
[*]Oak Staff's description: added "Earth-based attacks"
[*]Sacred Tree Armor to Armour
[*]"Assasination" skill name now corrected as "Assassination"
[*]Skill type "Assasinate" now corrected as "Assassinate"
[*]Mastery: Spectral & Light Armour is now corrected
[*]Fixed Book of Physical Study typo
[*]Windmill's "Mana Herb" item is now corrected
[*]The one NPC that gives Mana Flow items now correctly wants your Gold!
[*]Fixed Hellgel enemy's interaction typo... yeah
[*]Fixed the names of many "armor" to "armour"
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it's been a while since the last update. This new update will contain lots of fixes to the game. I hope you enjoy it.

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Burst and Blizzard Punch no longer can be sold
[*]Since you can get Health Cap on later parts of the game, you can now sell Health Cap
[*]Removed "Sun Ring"s "You can stack this effect" description, it's a unique item
[*]Fixed the 2 "Juliet" issue in Icywland!
[*]Icywland's Vendor now stops talking about letters!
[*]Fixed an issue with Hiban's dialogue in the "Alone Tree"
[*]In Robot Dome, fixed a dialogue issue when touching the password pannel.
[*]Fixed a typo in Seran with one of Qual's companions.
[*]Fixed Quizmaster's re-appearing pizza issue, only if you didn't loot it already :^)
[*]Boat giver NPC now correctly says that the boat is in the shore... instead of dock, because there is no dock.
[*]Sharp Arrow skill now has updated Description.
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*]Added Juliet to not so snowy Icywland!
[*]Added some new dialogues to not so snowy Icywland!
[*]Added a new dialogue in Seran after you met with the Witch
[*]When you got Good/Evil/Neutal cap the NPC near it will have a new dialogue.
[*]The girl near the church in Trin Island will now have a new dialogue after that specific hunt mission.
[/list]

Well, that's all for now. Thanks for playing Shattered Hourglass. Take care and stay safe.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Just noticed some achievements are not unlocking. So this patch brings you fixes and a new weapon for Bad and Neutral route.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Legendary Fisherman: If you've opened the "Timeless Weapon" chest already, interact with the chest again to gain the achievement!
[*] Super Early Bad Ending: It's now working as intended, my bad that I forgot to put extra "_" on my code.
[/list]

[b]New Weapon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Waste of Money achievement now gets you a new weapon, if you've Jannet in your party and 1 million gil on your side... (that's a lot) why not visit Chronix a visit?
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8f
notes.notes:
I just noticed that I've released 1.0.8 just a year ago, on this day...

[b]25/05/2021 - 27/05/2021[/b]

------------------------------------------------------------------------

+Fixed an issue that players may softlock their game in the post-game content in Chronix while searching for Mio
+In first tutorial screen where you see screen resolution and buttons, I wrote the wrong resolution... so I change "1280x920" to "1280x960"
+Chronix's Item Exchanger NPC now wants Black Belt and Mark separately!
+Sahagin monster now drops Black Belt and Health Cap armors
+Fixed Ghost Fish's Immunity bug (it now makes an ally immune to death for a turn)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Other than that I've started a new Rogue-like RPG~ I'll give you a small sneak-peak from the character screen.

Have a great day Time Travelers!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8: World Map Update
notes.notes:
[b]25/05/2020[/b]
------------------------

Alright, in this update we are getting World Maps. When you visit a town or a location the location's name will be shown on the map. Simple and effective I guess. Thanks to 'steverpg' for that suggestion.

[b]Added:[/b]
- 2 New World Map related items. You can find them in the chests,
+ One in Icywland "Map of Icdalen"
+ Another one in Seran "Map of Wlandia"
- Many World Map related images :')

notes.title: Steam Overlay Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
[b]05/15/2020[/b]
------------------------
[b]Disabled:[/b]
- Fullscreen buttons such as F4 and F5 are no more. You can do these options in the new F1 menu!
- No more difficulty options in the main menu, there will be an item that gives a better difficulty option, please read below.
- Disabled weird keyboard menu graphic when writing chest and door passwords. You can simply write passwords with your keyboard now

[b]Added:[/b]
- Steam Overlay! *F12 Intensifies*
- F1: Button; When in the game you can get detailed options where you can rebind your keys and adjust the screen resolution
- "Book of difficulty adjustment" item has been added to the game, you can get it from the same room as the first locked chest (Just left side of Lumberjack)

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Save/load/delete file confirmation is now on the top right side of the menu
- Oak slime now grants 50 exp (was 0)
- Some looping maps have changed to not looping counterparts (had to make some roadblocks... I'm sorry, if you are stuck please use Time Book or something)due I DON'T want to break my game.
(Such as Chapter II, World Map)

Due to these changes, especially adding Steam Overlay may take some performance... Save/Load menu may be a little slower now. Let's hope it'll be a smooth sail from now on.
